description: Pricing for the paid launch (MVP amendment). Step A proposed per-document purchase; the owner decided 2026-11-10 on the subscription model instead (Option B in PRICING_OPTIONS.md, unlimited documents) -- see PRICING_OPTIONS.md's 'Owner decision' section for what that changes. Every price point below is still a null placeholder for the owner to fill in. No price here has been picked from memory of competitors -- every priceUsd is null until the owner sets it.

subscription._note: Unlocks all 8 paywalled actions (PDF/.docx/plain text/JSON export, sources appendix, cloud save, e-signature, sharing) for every document for as long as the subscription is active. Triggers California's Automatic Renewal Law in full (Bus. & Prof. Code SS 17600 et seq.) -- renewal-compliance copy, acknowledgment email, and an easy-as-signup cancellation path are mandatory for this model, built in Step C.7, not optional.

perDocument._note: Not offered at launch under the subscription-only decision. Left in the file, inactive, in case the owner later wants a one-time option alongside the subscription -- not built unless asked.

refundPolicy._note: Owner decision -- Step E. For a subscription, this also covers partial-period refunds on cancellation. Not yet written.
